_comment: OLD MODEL IMAGES style catalog. Add new styles by appending an entry here — no code changes needed. If 'lora_path' is null or the file is missing at runtime, the app automatically falls back to the 'fallback_prompt_prefix'/'fallback_prompt_suffix' prompt-engineering path. 'lora_download' is only used by download_models.py; it is skipped gracefully when the file cannot be verified.
